The finding it lacks is that Dealectric's K&F Concept True Color 1–5 stop variable ND is $103.49 at 67 mm and $119.69 at 77 mm on kfconcept.com today. That undercuts the hard-stop VNDs from PolarPro (PMVND Edition II, from $149.99) and Freewell (Hard Stop, from $109.99), and Tiffen's Variable ND (from $109.00). decides: For video in a 67 mm or 77 mm size, this confirms the K&F True Color VND as the value pick. The K&F page claims only a 'reduced X effect', so the PolarPro PMVND Edition II or Freewell Hard Stop is the pick for anyone who wants guaranteed no-X hard stops. For long-exposure stills, a fixed ND such as the Breakthrough X4 is the better tool, because a variable ND tops out at 5 stops.
